description: This file contains a SQL script for creating a user-defined function called 'UDFStripHTMLTags' in a MySQL database, which strips HTML tags from input text. The script also includes setup commands such as USE and DROP for handling the function.

methods.name: UDFStripHTMLTags
methods.description: A user-defined function that removes HTML tags from a string by iteratively locating and deleting substrings enclosed in '<' and '>'.
